subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for channel-delivered agent context, with Slack populating file id, filename, MIME type, and size?
rationale: The missing behavior changes the agent-facing channel/plugin context and should be aligned across channel owners rather than patched as a Slack-only string format.

options.title: Add shared attachment metadata
options.body: Introduce a cross-channel attachment shape and migrate Slack first while preserving current placeholders and media fields.

options.title: Ship Slack-only metadata
options.body: Expose Slack metadata through a Slack-scoped untrusted context block, accepting later migration risk if other channels need parity.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Treat fileId placeholders plus download-file/media paths as sufficient and close the request after documenting the limitation.

recommendation.title: Add shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a cross-channel attachment shape and migrate Slack first while preserving current placeholders and media fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to both Slack media handling and shared channel inbound-media context.
